a.text: Pork is something Uzoamaka never eats.

b.text: Uzoamaka had a bowl of ramen at the stall by the station.

label: unclear
reason: Ramen broth may be pork, chicken or vegetable, and this bowl's is not named.

a.text: Rock concerts are something Philippa has always stayed away from.

b.text: Philippa watched a rock band's reunion concert on Friday night.

label: unclear
reason: Philippa may have been in the crowd or watching a broadcast of the reunion show.

a.text: Pawlu never sleeps more than six hours a night.

b.text: Pawlu went to bed at eleven and slept straight through until the alarm.

label: unclear
reason: The alarm time is not given, so the night may have been under or over six hours.

a.text: Tamuna gave up alcohol for good when she took up marathon running.

b.text: Tamuna drank eggnog at the holiday party.

label: unclear
reason: Eggnog is served spiked or plain, and the cup's contents are unknown.

a.text: Begoña doesn't have a driving licence.

b.text: Begoña toured the coast road in a hire car with a friend on Saturday.

label: unclear
reason: Who was at the wheel of the hire car is not stated.

a.text: Tsetseg grew up with electric cookers and has never cooked on gas.

b.text: Tsetseg made dinner for everyone at the holiday cottage last weekend.

label: unclear
reason: The cottage could have a gas or an electric hob, and its kitchen is not described.

a.text: Gaizka moved into the flat in March but has never met the landlord in person.

b.text: Gaizka argued with the landlord about the broken boiler.

label: unclear
reason: The argument might have happened by phone or on the doorstep.

a.text: Kabeya, who gets seasick, stays off boats entirely.

b.text: Kabeya had a day out on the island off the coast.

label: unclear
reason: Many islands near shore have a bridge as well as ferries, and this crossing is not described.

a.text: Amitai is now forty and has still never been on a plane.

b.text: Amitai went to a wedding on the other side of the country last weekend.

label: unclear
reason: How Amitai reached the far side of the country, by air or by land, goes unmentioned.

a.text: A kilometre is the farthest Ugne can swim without stopping.

b.text: Ugne swam thirty lengths of the pool without a break.

label: unclear
reason: Pool length is missing, and thirty lengths is under a kilometre in a short pool but over it in a long one.

a.text: Head office is a place Wendelin has never visited.

b.text: Wendelin sat in on the quarterly planning meeting with the head-office team on Tuesday.

label: unclear
reason: Joining online or sitting in the room are both possible for the planning meeting.

a.text: Signhild's dinner parties never go beyond six guests.

b.text: Signhild cooked dinner at home for the book club on Friday.

label: unclear
reason: Book club size is never given, and such groups often have between five and twelve members.

a.text: Nijat doesn't speak a word of Polish.

b.text: Nijat gave the welcome speech when a Polish handball team visited his club, and the guests loved it.

label: unclear
reason: The language of Nijat's welcome speech is never given, so he may have used his own language or tried Polish.

a.text: Þórir has not once attended a professional football match.

b.text: Þórir saw the derby with his brothers on Sunday afternoon.

label: unclear
reason: From the stands or on television: the derby's viewing place is missing.

a.text: Isidro has taken no paid work since he left the post office.

b.text: Isidro mowed lawns for three households on his street this morning.

label: unclear
reason: Payment for the mowing is never mentioned, so it could be a paid job or a neighbourly favour.

a.text: Cuthbert doesn't bake; the oven is now just a place to store pans.

b.text: Cuthbert brought a carrot cake to the office on his birthday.

label: unclear
reason: Shop-bought and home-baked cakes are both normal at work, and the source of this one is untold.

a.text: Tahoma never cooks.

b.text: Tahoma turned up at the street party with a big tray of lasagne.

label: unclear
reason: The lasagne's maker is not named, and bringing bought food to a street party is common.

a.text: Doli doesn't speak any French.

b.text: Doli led the guided tour of the museum for a group of French visitors.

label: unclear
reason: The language of the tour is missing; Doli may have guided the group in another tongue.

a.text: Sambath works only on weekdays.

b.text: Sambath spends every Saturday morning at the garage fixing motorbikes.

label: unclear
reason: Nothing shows if Sambath's Saturday mornings at the garage are paid work or a hobby.

a.text: Xuereb's never acted on a stage.

b.text: Xuereb was part of the community theatre's summer show.

label: unclear
reason: Cast member or backstage crew: the text never says which Xuereb was in the summer show.

a.text: Iñaki refuses to ride an e-bike.

b.text: Iñaki crossed the city on a rental bike.

label: unclear
reason: Rental schemes offer both pedal bikes and e-bikes, and the bike's kind is missing.

a.text: Coaching a team is not something Drita has ever tried.

b.text: Drita turned up to every under-tens football training session this spring.

label: unclear
reason: Her part at the under-tens sessions, coach or watching parent, is left out.

a.text: The largest audience Ruslana has sung for was under a hundred people.

b.text: Ruslana sang a solo at the choir's spring concert.

label: unclear
reason: Attendance at the spring concert is unrecorded, and choir audiences vary widely.

a.text: Eirlys has not been to the opera in her life.

b.text: Eirlys watched a full opera with her sister on Saturday evening.

label: unclear
reason: The opera may have been seen in a theatre or on a screen at home.

a.text: Jam-making is a skill Sjoerd never picked up.

b.text: Sjoerd handed out jars of plum jam at the school fete.

label: unclear
reason: Shop-bought or homemade, the jars' origin goes unstated.

a.text: Not a drop of alcohol passes Nodar's lips.

b.text: Nodar drank two glasses of punch at the neighbours' barbecue.

label: unclear
reason: Punch is made both with and without alcohol, and this batch is not described.

a.text: Mhairi won't drive through the estuary tunnel.

b.text: Mhairi drove across to the far side of the estuary for lunch.

label: unclear
reason: A bridge may or may not also cross the estuary, so the route Mhairi took is unknown.

a.text: Ceinwen can only drive automatics.

b.text: Ceinwen drove a hire car around the island for a week.

label: unclear
reason: Hire fleets carry both manual and automatic cars, and the gearbox is not mentioned.

a.text: Gervásio never works in the evenings.

b.text: Gervásio played guitar at a café until midnight on Friday.

label: unclear
reason: The café set might have been a paid gig or just an open-mic night for fun.

a.text: Farangis hasn't met her nephew's girlfriend yet.

b.text: Farangis talked with her nephew's girlfriend for an hour on Sunday.

label: unclear
reason: The talk could have been face to face or a video call, and the text does not say.

a.text: No crowd Bardhyl has played to has topped fifty people.

b.text: Bardhyl's band played an outdoor set at the summer street fair.

label: unclear
reason: Crowd size at the street fair is not reported and could fall either side of fifty.

a.text: Changing a tyre is something Mahala doesn't know how to do.

b.text: Mahala dealt with a flat tyre at the side of the road on the way home.

label: unclear
reason: Roadside help may have done the actual tyre change, and who did it is not said.
